traceability.notes: The 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT story is fully implemented. The codebase adds first-class @implements handling for both syntax/format validation and deep requirement existence checking, integrates @implements into function-level story and requirement rules, preserves backward compatibility with existing @story/@req annotations, supports mixed usage in the same comment/file, and provides error messages that clearly identify both the missing requirement and the story path. Tests explicitly targeted at this story exercise single-story, multi-story, and mixed scenarios and all pass, and documentation describes the new annotation format and migration behavior. Based on this concrete implementation and test evidence, the story is assessed as PASSED.
